steps.en: Notices needing an electronic reminder after the 2nd letter are selected
steps.id: Notice yang perlu reminder elektronik setelah surat ke-2 dipilih
steps.why_en: The reminder job is switched off in production, so it only runs when triggered by hand.
steps.why_id: Job reminder dimatikan di produksi, jadi hanya jalan kalau dipicu manual.

steps.en: The latest mobile number is checked at the data source and saved
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru dicek di sumber data dan disimpan
steps.why_en: The lookup for a newer mobile number is switched off in production, so the stored number is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian nomor mobile terbaru dimatikan di produksi, jadi nomor yang tersimpan dipakai.

steps.en: Offenders without a valid mobile number get no SMS
steps.id: Offender tanpa nomor mobile valid tidak dikirimi SMS
steps.why_en: The check works but sits in the reminder job that is switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan berfungsi tetapi ada di job reminder yang dimatikan di produksi.

steps.en: Offenders who opted out of electronic reminders are left out
steps.id: Offender yang opt out dari reminder elektronik dikecualikan
steps.why_en: The opt-out check is correct but sits in the reminder job that is switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Pengecekan opt-out sudah benar tetapi ada di job reminder yang dimatikan di produksi.
